title: Job: I Will Maintain My Integrity

questions.question: As God lives, who has taken away my what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:2 (ESV): "As God lives, who has taken away my right, and the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter,"

questions.question: As long as my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:3 (ESV): "as long as my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils,"

questions.question: My lips will not speak what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:4 (ESV): "my lips will not speak falsehood, and my tongue will not utter deceit."

questions.question: Till I die I will not put away my what from me?
questions.explanation: Job 27:5 (ESV): "Till I die I will not put away my integrity from me."

questions.question: I hold fast my righteousness and will not let it what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:6 (ESV): "I hold fast my righteousness and will not let it go; my heart does not reproach me for any of my days."

questions.question: For what is the hope of the godless when God cuts him off, when God takes away his what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:8 (ESV): "For what is the hope of the godless when God cuts him off, when God takes away his life?"

questions.question: Will God hear his cry when what comes upon him?
questions.explanation: Job 27:9 (ESV): "Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him?"

questions.question: Will he take delight in the Almighty? Will he call upon God at what times?
questions.explanation: Job 27:10 (ESV): "Will he take delight in the Almighty? Will he call upon God at all times?"

questions.question: I will teach you concerning the hand of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 27:11 (ESV): "I will teach you concerning the hand of God; what is with the Almighty I will not conceal."

questions.question: Why then have you become altogether what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:12 (ESV): "Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?"

questions.question: If his children are multiplied, it is for the what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:14 (ESV): "If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword, and his descendants have not enough bread."

questions.question: Those who survive him the pestilence buries, and his widows do not what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:15 (ESV): "Those who survive him the pestilence buries, and his widows do not weep."

questions.question: Though he heap up silver like dust, and pile up clothing like clay, he may pile it up, but the just will what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:16–17 (ESV): "he may pile it up, but the just will wear it, and the innocent will divide the silver."

questions.question: He builds his house like a moth's, like a booth that a what makes?
questions.explanation: Job 27:18 (ESV): "He builds his house like a moth's, like a booth that a watchman makes."

questions.question: The east wind lifts him up and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his what?
questions.explanation: Job 27:21 (ESV): "The east wind lifts him up and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place."

key_verse_text: Till I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
